added.name: material_search_counts_insert_v1

        INSERT INTO material_search_resource_counts_v1(resource_id,total,private) VALUES(new.resource_id,1,new.contains_personal_data<>0)
        ON CONFLICT(resource_id) DO UPDATE SET total=total+1,private=private+(new.contains_personal_data<>0); END

added.name: material_search_counts_update_v1
added.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER material_search_counts_update_v1 AFTER UPDATE OF resource_id,contains_personal_data ON resource_chunks
        WHEN old.resource_id<>new.resource_id OR old.contains_personal_data<>new.contains_personal_data BEGIN
        UPDATE material_search_resource_counts_v1 SET total=total-1,private=private-(old.contains_personal_data<>0) WHERE resource_id=old.resource_id;
        INSERT INTO material_search_resource_counts_v1(resource_id,total,private) VALUES(new.resource_id,1,new.contains_personal_data<>0)
        ON CONFLICT(resource_id) DO UPDATE SET total=total+1,private=private+(new.contains_personal_data<>0); END
